Vulnerability Management

أتمتة الاختبار

The application of automated tools and scripts to perform repeatable, consistent validation of cryptographic functions, PKI operations, and security controls during deployment, upgrade, or compliance processes.

Definition

The application of automated tools and scripts to perform repeatable, consistent validation of cryptographic functions, PKI operations, and security controls during deployment, upgrade, or compliance processes.

Operational example

Test automation is required in PKI environments to verify certificate lifecycle operations, cryptographic compliance, and security patch efficacy after system updates.
